title: Identical U-curve minima are all discarded and produce NaN focus
summary: Category functional; severity medium; confidence high. Owner coordinator; open, nonblocking audit follow-up. Add numerical unit cases for equal values, ordinary outliers and no usable minima. No movement was commanded.
